QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] Berry, Mayor of Fish
QuestInfo.0: You found yourself at a small seaside village after crossing Parbell's path. The weather there was gorgeous, so different from dreary Tynerum!\r\nYou decided to talk to the locals for more information and found a kind-looking old man in a shabby house. You asked him to tell you about the town, and he heartily agreed.
QuestInfo.1: He introduced himself as #e#bBerry#k#n, the mayor of the village. He said his little town was north of the #b#eCommerci Republic#k#n. You decided not to mention you were from Maple World, since you weren't sure how the locals would react.
QuestInfo.2: He introduced himself as #e#bBerry#k#n, the mayor of the village. He said his little town was north of the #b#eCommerci Republic#k#n. You decided not to mention you were from Maple World, since you weren't sure how the locals would react.\r\nApparently, numerous fishing villages were scattered near the #e#bCommerci Republic#k#n, due to it's location near the sea, but the center of trade was actually #b#eSan Commerci#k#n, the republic capital known for its trade.\r\nYou decided to stay a while to gather more information.
